{"notes": "Visit 3 (left 5:30). I only see and hear what happens while I'm at the table, and I don't know who placed which dominoes. The picture shows one continuous dark chain from the start (~28,4) along the top, round the nose at ~(4.5,11), and back along the bottom to a tail tip at ~(27,15.2). I see no pale or stray pieces and no gaps, and the nose joint is intact. The fish looks complete and connected with about 4.5 minutes left.

Omar: At 4:30 he spotted that the bottom line stopped short of the tail and said he'd extend it, checking first that Sofia wasn't already on it. At 5:15 he reported the tail done, and the picture matches: the line now reaches the tail tip. This closes my visit 2 question about whether anyone would follow through. He noticed the gap, took ownership and delivered, and his report was accurate. He also warned Sofia about the joint dominoes next to the strays and went to look, which was good risk awareness. Strong execution and collaboration. Ask him privately how the tail went.

Sofia: At 4:45 she spotted pale strays at the nose, said she was clearing them, and deferred the tail to Omar. At 5:00 she said she'd check the whole fish afterwards. The picture shows no strays and an intact nose joint, which is consistent with her report. Good judgment and clear communication. I can't confirm who removed the strays. Still to ask her: how the handoff with Omar felt.

Jack: Nothing heard or seen this visit. No gaps appear, which fits his earlier promise to watch the bottom line, but I can't credit him with it. Still undetermined.

Hana: Silent again, so no evidence either way. Don't infer anything. Ask her privately what she did.

Before the review: ask each person privately who did what, especially Jack and Hana."}
